title: deferred-circuit-coalescer-and-slo-cooling-hotpatch
author: Jin Park
description:
Motivation: recent incidents showed rapid, correlated circuit state flips across regional proxies when noisy tenants triggered transient downstream latency. That oscillation caused unnecessary regional failovers and SLO remediation thrash. This hotpatch introduces a deferred circuit coalescer that smooths circuit transitions, applies a short SLO-cooling window to reduce aggressive failover actions, and provides explicit telemetry for post-incident analysis.

What this PR does (summary): adds a lightweight coalescer component that groups circuit-open signals over a configurable time window, computes an aggregated severity score, and only triggers a full regional circuit transition if the score crosses thresholds. Meanwhile, for intermediate severities the system applies an SLO-cooling policy: temporarily relax per-tenant SLO enforcement thresholds and convert immediate failover actions into staged degraded routes (soft-evict -> rate-limit -> failover). The patch also exposes new Prometheus metrics and tracing spans to help investigate coalescing decisions.

Key design points: single-file coalescer state is sharded by region and by tenant-priority-bucket to minimize lock contention. The coalescer keeps a short event ring buffer per shard, computes an exponential backoff for repeated opens, and emits a coalesced_event with reason, weight, and suggested action. SLO-cooling is timeboxed and conservative: nominal relaxed_margin defaults to 10% for 30s and is downgraded if errors continue. All defaults are tunable via config flags and a feature-gate for progressive rollout.

Rollback and safety: feature-gate defaults to off. For the hotpatch we enable the gate in canary (us-east-1 small cohort) and have a fast revert path (toggle feature-gate) plus a dedicated emergency endpoint to force immediate circuit resets if needed. No persistent migrations.

Testing and verification: added unit tests for coalescer scoring, integration test that simulates bursty tenant events to assert no more than one immediate region-wide failover in the window, and a synthetic load canary harness run in perf-canary that validated latency tail improvement and reduced flip count under noise.

Operational notes / rollout: enable feature-gate "deferred_circuit_coalescer" in canary region for 48h, monitor new metrics (coalescer_coalesced_events_total, coalescer_decision_latency_seconds, slo_cooling_applied_total). If flip-rate decreases and application error SLOs remain acceptable, expand to 3 regions over one week.

Files changed: small changes in circuit manager (Go), config, telemetry collector, and a new coalescer package. No changes to customer-facing API.

Why unique: rather than lowering thresholds globally or making longer cooldowns (which harmed healthy tenants), the coalescer defers action and uses aggregated signals so that transient correlated noise is handled as a group without aggressive per-tenant penalties.

review_conversation: 2026-02-21 Leah Martinez: Nice approach. Two asks: (1) please add a metric for "coalescer_suppressed_open_total" so we can quantify suppression, (2) ensure the ring buffer has an upper bound to avoid OOM under pathological signal storms.
2026-02-22 Jin Park: Thanks — added coalescer_suppressed_open_total and cap the ring buffer to 1024 events per shard. Updated unit tests for the cap.

2026-02-23 Marco Santoro: Safety nit — can we make the default feature-gate OFF in config.yaml and document the manual enable procedure in the runbook? Also add a short-circuit in manager to bypass coalescer for admin-forced resets.
2026-02-24 Jin Park: Done. Feature-gate default set to false and runbook updated. Added admin bypass endpoint with auth checks.
2026-02-25 Ethan Cole: Ran perf-canary smoke. Observed 42% reduction in flip-rate and tail latency improved by ~6th percentile. Approving to merge after CI green.

release_notes: Hotpatch: Add deferred circuit coalescer and timeboxed SLO-cooling to smooth regional failovers and reduce circuit flip thrash. Feature gated, canary rollout recommended. Metrics and runbook included.
notes_for_oncall: If observing unexpected broad degradation after enabling, toggle feature-gate 'deferred_circuit_coalescer' to false to revert. Emergency endpoint /admin/circuits/reset?force=true exists with RBAC checks. Monitor coalescer_suppressed_open_total and slo_cooling_applied_total to ensure expected behavior.
qa_summary: Unit tests for scoring and buffer cap added. Integration tests simulate bursty tenants, verifying no more than one regional failover per 60s window in the canary scenario. Perf-canary run validated stability under noise and reduced flip-rate.
